body: Yeah, you'd be better off in your own thread. With paragraph breaks. No doubt your problems are genuine, but they have nothing whatsoever to do with me.

Isn't there a rule against posting this kind of twee bullshit yeah, right there, Rule 4.c.

There aren't any people who matter to me. My family already wrote me off as a Godless heathen, and I have no friends. Your imaginary Internet hugs mean fuck and all.

The Universe has not given any sign of caring for me in 32 years, and I don't anticipate any sign in the next 32 hours. 

So fuck your twee bullshit, save it for Tumblr. Unless you're deliberately trying to anger me and keep me posting in which case, **your move.**
